An '''anti-radiation inoculation''' was a preventative medical treatment to negate an individual's exposure to [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. Smart [[Starship/Legends|starship]] maintenance personnel who regularly worked with radioactive components, such as [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]], ensured they had periodic inoculations to remain healthy.<ref name="SWS" />
